thread:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT PAGER: elevated 5xx/timeout rate observed on /v1/generate (prod-eu). Severity: P2. Start: 2026-03-15T12:01:00Z. Please ack and follow incident runbook.
mira: acked. i'm oncall for infra. jumping in.
alexandra: on it too — product/ops standby. customer-facing triage: sending note to CS after we have impact estimates.
samir: looking at ingress metrics now. spike in 502/504 from edge -> gateway starting ~12:01 and peaking ~12:07. attaching quick sample logs below.
ops-bot: KVLOG link: https://logs.redwood/kv/stream?query=service:gateway+status:5\n(links pinned)
jules: grabbing correlation ids for failing requests, will paste a compact batch.
---
jules: ```
req_id=cid:eu-0001 path=/v1/generate status=502 upstream=model-router-3 retries=4 latency_ms=1100
req_id=cid:eu-0002 path=/v1/generate status=504 upstream=egress-proxy timeout_ms=10000
req_id=cid:eu-00a3 path=/v1/generate status=502 upstream=model-router-1 retries=6 latency_ms=980
```
---
mira: thanks. those retries=6 lines look suspicious. can someone check egress retry counts from gateway -> model cluster?
samir: running quick grep across logs, pattern shows burst of upstream retries from gateway between 12:00:30-12:08:00. sample trace id cid:eu-00a3 shows repeated 500s from model-router-1 before final 502 back to client.
alexandra: customer-impact: CS reports 2 enterprise customers saw elevated errors in EU region starting ~12:02. pushing to CS: "we're investigating; mitigation in progress" :hourglass_flowing_sand:
mira: live mitigation idea: enable immediate fallback routing to small-3b model variant for /v1/generate in eu region to reduce upstream pressure, and throttle large batch sizes for in-flight requests. any objections?
jules: +1, prefer fallback to avoid wide rollback. also recommend temporarily disable aggressive egress retries at gateway (reduce max_retries from 6 to 2) to prevent retry amplification.
lauren: if we reduce retries we could expose more 5xx to callers but reduce cascading. i'd prefer fallback + reduced retries.
samir: implementing change: updating gateway config to max_retries=2 for /v1/generate in eu staging of production route, applying canary to 20% traffic now.
---
samir: ```bash
# gateway patch (canary)
kubectl -n gateway patch config gateway-config --patch '{"routeOverrides":{"/v1/generate":{"max_retries":2}}}'
# apply fallback routing ruleredwoodctl routes set-fallback --route /v1/generate --region eu --fallback-model small-3b --weight 0.20
```
---
ops-bot: Deploy job started: job_id=dep-98765. Canary traffic 20%.
mira: monitoring latency/5xx now. initial canary shows 5xx rate on canary slice dropped from 6.8% -> 1.3% within 90s.
alexandra: CS notified customers with interim update. asking for per-customer impact numbers to include in followup.
jules: collecting timeline so far:
 - 12:00:28 UTC: first elevated retries seen in gateway metrics
 - 12:01:05 UTC: oncall pager triggered
 - 12:02:10 UTC: spike in retries to model-router-1 and model-router-3
 - 12:03:15 UTC: first customer reports to CS
 - 12:04:00 UTC: gateway retry cap reduced (canary)
 - 12:05:30 UTC: fallback routing enabled (20% canary -> then gradually increasing)
 - 12:07:10 UTC: 5xx rate starts falling across regional slice
 - 12:30:00 UTC: mitigations rolled to 100% routing for fallback+retry cap

mira: note: we saw a correlated increase in CPU on model-router-3 around the spike window. possible slowdowns causing retries.
samir: hypothesis A: transient model-serving CPU contention causing repeated upstream failures -> gateway retries amplify -> client-facing 502/504. Evidence: CPU spike, retries field, repeated 5xx in model-router logs.
alexandra: hypothesis B: network egress flaps between gateway and northbound model cluster causing timeouts. Evidence: some 504 lines and occasional 'connection reset' in egress proxy logs.
jules: what we need: per-request end-to-end traces for a few correlation ids (cid:eu-0001, cid:eu-00a3) and model-router host metrics (cpu, queue depth) around 12:00-12:10.
samir: attached trace for cid:eu-0001:
```
trace(cid:eu-0001): gateway->model-router-3 [attempt1: 500] -> gateway retry -> model-router-3 [attempt2: 500] -> attempt3: timeout -> gateway returns 502
```
mira: I pulled model-router-3 host metrics: cpu jump 65% -> 92% at 12:02 with GC pauses noted in process logs. queue depth spiked to 120 requests queued (normal ~10).
alexandra: that strongly supports hypothesis A. ops-bot, can you surface infra autoscaler events? did any autoscale fail or lag?
ops-bot: autoscaler logs: scale-up triggered at 12:02:35 but new pods did not register readiness until ~12:05:20 due to image pull + initialization backlog (image registry latency). scale timeline attached.
jules: that chain explains both CPU pressure and the retry avalanche. mitigation successful because fallback reduced heavy models and gateway retries reduced amplification.
mira: actions now:
 - (hot) postmortem lead: jules
 - (hot) create SR to registry team about image pull latency (ticket REG-221)
 - (hot) temporary change: set gateway max_retries=2 permanently for /v1/generate until follow-up
 - (hot) autoscaler tweak: pre-warm policy for peak windows by increasing min_replicas for model-router-3 in eu
 - (followup) thorough RCA doc with timeline, graphs, and action owners

alexandra: i'll draft customer update for the enterprise accounts impacted. include mitigation + timeline + ETA for permanent fixes.
samir: saving extracted KV logs and traces to incident S3: s3://incidents/2147654321/artifacts/
jules: adding note: we should add better readiness health checks to avoid long init windows; also consider image caching/registry mirrors in eu region.
mira: status: mitigations applied to 100% traffic at 12:30. 5xx error rate back to baseline ~0.2%. marking incident as mitigated. moving to post-incident RCA channel for writeup.
alexandra: thanks team — please put any remaining artifacts in the s3 folder and assign owners for followups. :thumbsup:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated. Please continue with RCA and assign postmortem within 48h.
